review_mode: Independent read-only exact source and full composition review; no builds or edits
findings: The theorem has no initial protected-target invariant, supplied initializer success or supplied final world. FactoryInitializedCall derives actual initialization and Invariant0 from the selected child under explicit deployment inputs.

Entry gas is the actual UInt256.ofNat(gasLimit-intrinsicGas). Natural subtraction is bounded by gasLimit<UInt256.size, so conversion is exact and entryGas<=gasLimit is derived before using the external gasLimit<=2^64 envelope.

TransactionFactoryEntry obtains the exact factory account in the admitted checkpoint, remaining value funding, checkpoint total bound and installed toExecute selection. No unrelated code or pre-transfer world is substituted.

Fuel c.fuel=steps+19 yields MessageCall.Context.fuel=steps+18; that call supplies the existing Xi/CREATE2/initializer fuel chain. Permission, apparent value and depth gates are instantiated from actual top-level transaction context fields.

FactoryInitializedCall produces one cr/pw/remaining/ss tuple. Its exact call equation is projected through the actual recipient-selected provisional transaction branch with success=true; no independent provisional-success premise is introduced.

Initializer-derived log/selfDestruct preservation specializes to empty entry fields because RefundAccounting.entrySubstate updates only A0 access accounts/keys. Thus empty final logs and selfDestructSet are derived on this same ss, and protected-address nonmembership for cleanup follows directly.

TransactionJournalEdges.settled_codeAt_frame uses the produced invariant code witness and derived selfDestruct nonmembership. Nonempty installed runtime protects the account during actual cleanup; refund and beneficiary credits, account erasure and transient clearing preserve protected code/persistent storage. JournalInvariant.frame transports the invariant to exactly TransactionFunding.settledWorld.

TransactionFunding.result_equation is the literal actual Upsilon refund/payment/cleanup equation. Rewriting the produced provisional tuple proves c.result success with the same final settled world and ss; used is the actual netGas expression, not an assumed receipt amount.

The strengthening quantifies other and budget after the same produced committed-world witness: other!=kind and Invariant other budget c.world imply Invariant other budget w. It does not assume an invariant for the newly initialized target, and does not change the other invariant budget.

Concrete kind case analysis proves factory/other-address and target/other-address inequalities. Actual checkpoint_frame followed by the same Theta hframes yields a frame from original c.world to provisional pw, transporting the supplied other invariant at identical budget.

The produced provisional other CodeAt and derived empty selfDestructSet justify settled_codeAt_frame for the other address. A second JournalInvariant.frame transports to exactly the returned TransactionFunding.settledWorld, including refund/payment/cleanup. No target nonmembership or nonempty code premise is smuggled in; both derive from already available fields/invariant.

This supports linked two-deployment composition at one resulting world when each actual transaction input is supplied. It does not itself construct the second transaction, canonical initial factory history, or its admission/collision/hash witnesses.
assumptions_and_limits: Retains numeric TransactionFunding.Admission, installed factory code/nonce, distinct sender/factory, actual recipient and exact factory calldata, pre-world funds<UInt256.size, entry gas>=1M, transaction gasLimit<=2^64, steps>=13/exact fuel, actual child collision freedom and canonical preimage-address equation. Canonical signature/type/fork admission and installation/history producers remain open.
The transaction gas-width bound is explicit; it is not derived from block-number width or mistaken for a native UInt256 property. The pre-world funding ceiling still needs a history/ledger producer.

This proves a successful pinned Upsilon deployment transaction, strengthening the earlier Theta-only boundary. It does not prove canonical mainnet factory deployment history, cryptographic address identity, reference Amsterdam evaluator/gas correspondence or protocol adoption.
The output of Upsilon here carries no call return-data field; canonical20-byte return encoding is proved in the nested call theorem and is not falsely added to the transaction result tuple.
Future history seed construction must link this actual committed transaction and its pre-world funding history; this module alone does not assert such a canonical history.
